create_MjRenderPool: create a MjRenderPool with a MuJoCo model to render across multiple GPU devices
render_batch_images: render a batch of MuJoCo simulation states as RGB images using MjRenderPool render method
render_with_depth: render MuJoCo simulation states with depth maps by passing depth=True to the render method
randomize_and_render: randomize domain parameters before rendering by passing randomize=True to the render method
close_render_pool: close the MjRenderPool and terminate child worker processes using the close method
